examples.text: Georg Büchner, Dantons Tod. Ein Drama (Condor Bibliothek im Apollo Verlag, Lindau, p. 50)
examples.english: The world is the Eternal Jew, the vacuum (Nought) is Death, but that is impossible.
examples.translation: The world is the Eternal Jew, the vacuum (Nought) is Death, but that is impossible.
examples.roman: CAMILLE: Die Welt ist der Ewige Jude, das Nichts ist der Tod, aber er ist unmöglich.

examples.text: Karl Marx (1978) [1845], “Thesen über Feuerbach”, in Marx-Engels-Werke, volume 3, page 7; English translation from Marx/Engels Collected Works, volume 5, 1976, page 5
examples.english: The philosophers have only interpreted the world in various ways; the point is to change it.
examples.translation: The philosophers have only interpreted the world in various ways; the point is to change it.
examples.roman: Die Philosophen haben die Welt nur verschieden interpretiert, es kömmt drauf an, sie zu verändern.

raw.etymology_text: Inherited from Middle High German wëlt, assimilative contraction of older wërlt, from Old High German wëralt, from Proto-West Germanic *weraldi, from Proto-Germanic *weraldiz. Cognate to English world, Dutch wereld, Swedish värld.
